objectives: Decode taught ee words by blending consonants and reading the vowel team as a unit.
Explain how ee is a common vowel team representing long e in these taught words.
Check accuracy by rereading the whole word or sentence.
concepts: ee is a common vowel team representing long e in these taught words
A vowel team uses two letters to represent a vowel sound in a taught spelling pattern.
Readers blend the consonants and read the vowel team as a unit.
Fresh examples test transfer beyond memorised responses.

definitions.definition: Two letters that work together to represent a vowel sound.
Using letter-sound knowledge to read a written word.
Applying a learned skill to a new example.

workedExamples.prompt: Read “green”. Which letters form the vowel team?
workedExamples.solution: The letters ee work together to represent long e.

workedExamples.prompt: A learner reads “sleep” with a short vowel. What should be checked?
workedExamples.solution: Notice the ee vowel team and reread the word with long e.

workedExamples.prompt: Why try a fresh example after guided practice?
workedExamples.solution: A new item checks whether the learner can use the skill independently.
